findings.title: Rabb as sustained stage-by-stage care
findings.claim: The focus title Rabb can carry an ongoing relation of guiding the House community from provision and safety through successive conditions, so lordship is perceived as active maintenance as well as authority.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier رَبَّ ordinarily names the Lord and owner of the House. The supplied wider provisioned-town relation in 16:112 places security, abundant provision, and the loss of both in one external frame; that contact makes the title's staged repair and completion pressure materially visible in the focus command.
findings.reader_payoff: The named Lord becomes perceptible as the one whose relation to the House community is maintained through changing conditions, not only as a static title of rank.
findings.containment: The ordinary lordship reading remains intact. The stage-by-stage care is a qualified wider resonance, and the supplied target lacks target morphology; it does not assert that 106:3 alone narrates every stage or that care replaces ownership.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch and trusted publication are supplied, while the wider connection supplies exact target Arabic without target morphology and the maintenance relation remains inferential.

findings.title: The House as a protected household
findings.claim: The focus House can be heard as the people attached to a home, so the worship command places a cared-for household relation around the named sanctuary as well as naming its location.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier ٱلْبَيْتِ ordinarily names the definite House. The wider domestic prayer that includes those who enter a house in faith, together with a wider provision-and-security town frame, supplies separate household and care triggers; their contact shifts the House from a bare place-name toward the people bound to it.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive why a House can gather people into a household relation while the Rabb remains the one to whom that relation is directed.
findings.containment: The physical sanctuary and the ordinary definite reference remain recoverable. The unregistered stepfamily/caregiver branch is excluded; this finding does not assert a literal biological or non-biological family structure for every member of the focus community.

epistemic.reason: The citable publication and focus household branch are supplied, while the wider domestic and provision triggers have limited target analysis and the retained relation is bounded to the household core.

findings.title: The House as shelter, household, and social center

findings.mechanism: The focus House carrier retains its shelter core and gathering extension. 3:96 supplies a House established for people, 5:97 describes the sacred House as a stabilizing center for people, 71:28 gives a communal domestic frame, and 27:26 supplies the wider owner-directed lordship boundary; together these distinct contacts make shelter, gathering, household, and honor materially interact around the focus noun.
findings.reader_payoff: This House becomes legible as a place that organizes a people and their belonging, not merely as an object named after the worship command.
findings.containment: The focus still denotes the known sanctuary. The social-center and identity effect is a qualified wider resonance, not a complete surah architecture or an exclusive replacement for the physical House.

epistemic.reason: The trusted publication explicitly anchors all three focus branches; the external connections provide distinct target Arabic triggers, but their target morphology is not supplied.

findings.title: Shelter carried outward into exposed routes
findings.claim: The House's shelter relation can extend outward to the exposed routes around it, making the command resonate with a protected movement through surrounding fear.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier ٱلْبَيْتِ names a dwelling and shelter. 29:67 places a secure sanctuary amid surrounding capture, and 48:27 joins entry into the Sacred Mosque with safe communal arrival; these wider contacts return to the House carrier and change its scale from interior shelter to shelter whose effect reaches vulnerable approach routes.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees how a House can be both a place of refuge and an anchor for people who must approach it through danger.
findings.containment: The shelter core remains primary. The night-action branch is excluded, and the route extension is a qualified wider relation; the focus does not itself state a complete security policy for every journey.

epistemic.reason: Trusted and legacy source records agree on the shelter carrier, while two exact wider target texts support the security extension without supplying target morphology.

findings.title: Worship as a made-passable route
findings.claim: The worship verb can carry an additional image of a way made passable through repeated movement, so the command gathers direction toward a sacred center.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier يَعْبُدُوا۟ ordinarily names directed worship and obedient service. The wider pilgrimage movement between sacred landmarks in 2:158 supplies an independent route trigger; contact with the road facet makes submission perceptible as yielding resistance and becoming traversable, while the focus command remains an act of worship.
findings.reader_payoff: Worship becomes newly visible as an oriented way of moving through resistance, not only as an inward attitude or detached ritual label.
findings.containment: The road is an analogical resonance, not a claim that the verb literally builds a road. The scattering branch is excluded because no independent global activation lands it, and the publication's broader B005+B010 record is retained as counter-evidence.

epistemic.reason: A legacy reader walk and the focus branch provide the road image, while the trusted publication labels the broader finding reject; the retained relation is therefore bounded to an analogical B005 core.

findings.title: Honor redirected from the House to its Lord
findings.claim: The command redirects the honor surrounding the House and its lineage toward the Lord who owns it, while the worship verb also names the recipient as one honored and served.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers يَعْبُدُوا۟, رَبَّ, and ٱلْبَيْتِ place obedient service before the House's Lord. 6:102 supplies the Lord-as-owner-and-worship target relation, 3:64 supplies the exclusive worship and rejection of rival lords, and the 27:26 return frames the revered local institution against its true owner; these contacts cause House prestige and the honored-service recipient to converge on the Rabb named here.
findings.reader_payoff: The House's status no longer floats as an independent source of glory: the command makes its honor point through the one to whom worship is owed.
findings.containment: The ordinary command to worship the House's Lord remains intact. The prestige correction is a bounded wider inference; it does not deny the House's honor or claim that every honor use of Bayt is active here.

epistemic.reason: The trusted anchored publication and legacy worship walk supply the relevant branches, while wider target texts provide distinct owner, exclusivity, and honor-direction triggers without target morphology.

findings.title: Rabb as guarantor of a protected order
findings.claim: Rabb can acquire a bounded guarantor dimension in which the House's secure order is held together by binding protection as well as by lordship.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier رَبَّ ordinarily names the Lord of the House. Wider secure-sanctuary and safe-entry relations in 29:67 and 48:27 supply independent protection triggers; in contact with the covenant-and-guarantee facet, they make Rabb legible as the one who holds a protected order together.
findings.reader_payoff: Security around the House becomes perceptible as a maintained relation of assurance, so the worship command can be heard against a background of reliable protection.
findings.containment: No named human treaty is asserted, and the ordinary Lord/owner reading remains primary. The publication's reject grade is live counter-evidence; this is an exploratory covenantal resonance only.

epistemic.reason: The qualified branch and legacy reader nomination are present, but the trusted publication records a reject grade and the external texts supply security rather than an explicit pact.

findings.title: Worship as response within a provisioned order
findings.claim: The commanded worship can be heard as the response that belongs within an order already made possible by provision and security.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier يَعْبُدُوا۟ names directed worship-service, while the prefixed fa- turns the preceding relation into the command that follows. The wider 16:112 relation places a secure, provisioned community beside its failure to answer that benefaction; that independent contact changes the focus command into a responsive act within maintained livelihood.
findings.reader_payoff: The command no longer arrives as a detached ritual instruction: its response-shape becomes perceptible against the conditions that make communal life possible.
findings.containment: The grammatical command and ordinary worship meaning remain intact. The benefaction-to-obligation arrow is an inferred wider relation, not a claim that the focus explicitly states a complete economic theory.

epistemic.reason: The legacy reader walk supplies the changed relation, and 16:112 supplies exact wider target Arabic; the causal response arrow is explicitly inferential and target morphology is absent.

branch_activations.activation: Dış ayetteki provision-and-security düzeni, worship taşıyıcısının bağlı olduğu itaat eylemini bu düzenin karşılığı olarak temasa getirir.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟, sürdürülen güven ve geçimin içinde karşılığı verilmesi gereken yönelmiş worship olarak okunur.
branch_activations.boundary: Bu, fa- ile kurulan cevabiyetin wider resonance'ıdır; worship kelimesi ekonomik ödeme veya yalnızca minnettarlıkla sınırlandırılmaz.

findings.title: Rabb as nurturer of a House-centered people
findings.claim: The Rabb title can be heard as the one who repairs, develops, and completes the people gathered around the House, making worship a response to nurturing lordship.
findings.mechanism: The focus Rabb carrier retains its ordinary lordship relation. The wider community that consumes its Rabb's provision and answers with gratitude in 34:15 independently supplies a provision-and-response scene; that contact activates the staged-development facet and makes the House relation feel like care for dependents rather than bare superiority.
findings.reader_payoff: The worshippers become perceptible as a people whose relation to the Rabb includes being raised and sustained, not only obeying a superior.
findings.containment: The focus's Lord and worship relation remains recoverable. The source's unresolved ط ع م/B002 citation is not treated as a registered branch, and the result does not assert a literal parent-child structure for the community.

epistemic.reason: The focus B002 branch is supplied and 34:15 gives an exact wider provision-and-gratitude trigger, but the reader source is legacy-unbound and the nurturing arrow is inferential.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Süreç, gözetilen şeyi eksik durumdan tamamlanmış duruma doğru geliştirir.
branch_activations.carrier: رَبَّ, House'un Rabb'i olarak taşıdığı lordship adı içinde gözetilen şeyi geliştiren süreç ilişkisine açılır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 34:15'te bir topluluk Rabb'inin rızkını tüketmeye ve O'na şükretmeye çağrılır.
branch_activations.activation: Rabb'in rızkı ile topluluğun cevabı arasındaki dış ilişki, focus Rabb'i eksikliği giderip topluluğu tamamlayan bakım sürecine bağlar.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: House'un Rabb'ine kulluk, kendisini ve çevresini besleyip tamamlayan bir Rabb'e verilen karşılık olarak da görünür.
branch_activations.boundary: Bu, staged-development facet'inin bağlamsal uygulanışıdır; evlatlık/bakıcı dalı, kayıtsız bir yiyecek kökü veya bütün bakım anlamları eklenmez.

findings.title: Retrospective convergence of shelter, care, and honor
findings.claim: Across the retained wider contacts, the House can be seen as a shelter and social center, Rabb as its sustaining Lord, and the honor of the House as derivative of that sustaining relation.
findings.mechanism: The focus House carrier meets the secure-sanctuary relation in 29:67, the Rabb carrier meets the provisioned-town relation in 16:112, and the House-honor carrier meets the true-owner relation in 27:26. These three independent returns preserve the retrospective record's distinct before-and-after changes without importing its unsupported caregiving or non-focus nominated branch.
findings.reader_payoff: The three fixed words begin to explain one another: shelter gives a people a center, Rabb gives that center sustained life, and honor points back through the center's Lord.
findings.containment: This is a qualified retrospective synthesis of three separately anchored contacts, not a surah thesis and not a claim that one of the three readings governs the others. The root_000532/B005 and root_000551/B007 obligations are explicitly excluded.

epistemic.reason: The retrospective reader source is legacy-unbound; each retained branch nevertheless has a focus carrier and a separate wider connection, while the source's unsupported branches are recorded as exclusions.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel anlam, gece kalınan ve dönülen barınak ya da meskendir.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: 29:67 güvenli harem ile çevresindeki güvensizliği yan yana getirir.
branch_activations.activation: Güvenli merkez ile çevresindeki tehlike, House shelter carrier'ını iç mekândan dışa uzanan koruyucu merkez olarak yeniden çerçeveler.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: House, hareket eden insanların geri döndüğü ve çevresindeki tehlikeye karşı güven taşıyan bir mesken olarak görünür.
branch_activations.boundary: Bu aktivasyon shelter çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; gece işi, ev halkı veya yolculuk mekanizmasının bütün ayrıntıları bu dalda birleştirilmez.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Süreç, gözetilen şeyi eksik durumdan tamamlanmış duruma doğru geliştirir.
branch_activations.carrier: رَبَّ, House'a bağlı topluluğun Rabb'i olarak taşıdığı lordship adı içinde geliştirme sürecine açılır.

branch_activations.activation: Dış owner-direction teması, House'un şeref carrier'ını Rabb'in sürdürdüğü ve yönettiği bir itibara bağlar.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: House'un itibarı kendi başına duran bir övünç değil, House'un Rabbine dönen bir ilişki olarak görünür.
branch_activations.boundary: Bu, soy şerefi facet'inin ayrı ve nitelikli bir aktivasyonudur; fiziksel shelter ve Rabb-care okumalarını silmez.

findings.title: Worship as the answer to received provision
findings.claim: The worship command can be heard as a responsive service inside a provisioned order, where the House and its Rabb form the conditions to which worship answers.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier يَعْبُدُوا۟ names worship and submissive obedience, and its object is Rabb of the House. The wider relation in 100:6 identifies human ingratitude toward the Lord as a contrary response to benefaction; that independent contact makes worship newly legible as the directed answer to received provision while preserving its ordinary devotional force.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees a relation between being sustained and turning in worship, with the command situated inside a larger economy of received care.
findings.containment: This response reading supports the primary imperative and does not reduce worship to repayment. It is distinct from the road analogy and does not claim that the global relation supplies a full account of the focus's preceding seasonal context.

epistemic.reason: The wide reader walk supplies the worship-response claim and 100:6 supplies a concrete wider contrary-benefaction relation; the causal reading remains inferential and target morphology is absent.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Merkezî dinsel kullanım, Tanrı'ya yönelen tapınma ve kendini bu yönelişe vermedir.
branch_activations.carrier: يَعْبُدُوا۟, Rabb'e yönelen devotional worship ve kendini bu yönelişe verme eylemidir.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 100:6 Lord'a karşı insan nankörlüğünü, received care'a karşı ters cevap olarak görünür kılar.
branch_activations.activation: Dış ayetteki benefaction ve nankörlük karşıtlığı, focus worship carrier'ının alınmış nimete yönelen karşılık facet'ini bağımsız biçimde tetikler.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Evin Rabbine worship, Rabb'in sürdürdüğü yaşam koşullarına cevap veren yönelmiş hizmet olarak da okunur.
branch_activations.boundary: Bu, worship'in devotional çekirdeğine eklenen response resonance'ıdır; ibadet bütünüyle ekonomik karşılığa indirgenmez.

findings.title: The House as a collective body
findings.claim: The demonstrative and definite House together fix a nearby shelter that can also hold the collective body gathered around it.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier ٱلْبَيْتِ retains the shelter core and its gathering extension, while 3:96 and 5:97 independently present a House established for people and functioning as their stabilizing center. Their contact changes the deictic House from a bare architectural pointer into a local center around which a people can be organized.
findings.reader_payoff: The phrase this House becomes spatially and socially concrete at once: it points to a place and to the people whose belonging is organized around that place.
findings.containment: The focus reference to the known sanctuary remains primary. The collective-body effect is a qualified wider resonance and does not assert an entire seasonal system or a full social history.

epistemic.reason: The legacy walk supplies the local social-body change and the external House relations provide exact target Arabic, but target morphology and the inferred organizational relation are absent.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: 5:97 kutsal House'u insanlar için sabitleyici ve düzenleyici merkez olarak sunar.
branch_activations.activation: Dış merkez ilişkisi, House taşıyıcısının sakinleri toplama extension'ını doğrudan harekete geçirir.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: House, topluluğun kendisini bulduğu ve etrafında ortak yöneliş kurduğu merkez olarak da okunur.
branch_activations.boundary: Toplama ilişkisi House'un shelter çekirdeğine bağlıdır; kurumsal bir surah-wide system olarak adlandırılmaz.

findings.title: Ownership and covenantal protection together
findings.claim: The Rabb of this House can be heard both as its owner-ruler and as the guarantor of a protected order gathered around it.
findings.mechanism: The focus Rabb carrier supplies ownership and command authority. 6:102 independently joins Rabb, creator, and worship, while 29:67 independently joins sanctuary security with surrounding vulnerability; together they activate the candidate's paired owner and covenant facets without making the inferred pact literal.
findings.reader_payoff: The title holds two connected relations at once: the House belongs under a ruling Rabb, and its protected order can be experienced as held by that Rabb.
findings.containment: Ownership and ordinary lordship remain visible. Covenant is a qualified exploratory extension from security, not a named treaty, tax relation, or replacement for the primary title.

epistemic.reason: The legacy wide reader walk supplies both branch nominations and the external records provide separate owner and sanctuary-security triggers, but the covenantal arrow is inferred and target morphology is absent.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: 6:102 Allah'ı Rabb ve yaratıcı olarak adlandırıp worship'i O'na yöneltir.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Bu House'un Rabb'i, ona ait düzeni yöneten ve worship'in hak sahibi olan owner-ruler olarak belirginleşir.
branch_activations.boundary: Bu aktivasyon sahiplik ve yönetme çekirdeğindedir; covenant facet'i bu aynı carrier'ın ayrı aktivasyonudur.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: 29:67 güvenli harem ile çevredeki güvensizliği karşılaştırır ve bu güveni belirgin bir sanctuary relation olarak verir.
branch_activations.activation: Sanctuary'nin dış tehlikeye rağmen korunması, Rabb carrier'ının bağlayıcı güvence facet'iyle temas ederek korumayı tutulmuş bir düzen gibi gösterir.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Rabb, sahip olduğu House'un çevresinde güvenilir bir bağlılık ve koruma düzenini tutan guarantor olarak da duyulur.
branch_activations.boundary: Açık pact, insan tarafları veya vergi uzantısı ileri sürülmez; güvenlikten covenantal protection'a geçiş exploratory'dir.

findings.title: Provision and movement reframing the command
findings.claim: The worship command can hold two simultaneous wider effects: it answers staged provision, and it can be pictured as a passable route toward the House.
findings.mechanism: The focus Rabb carrier meets the wider provision-and-gratitude scene in 34:15, while the focus worship carrier meets the wider pilgrimage movement between landmarks in 2:158. The two independent contacts preserve separate mechanisms and change the command in two directions without collapsing one into the other.
findings.reader_payoff: Provision gives worship a responsive dimension, while movement gives it an oriented path dimension; both remain attached to the same plain command.
findings.containment: The Rabb title and worship imperative remain ordinary and recoverable. The provision-to-obligation arrow and worship-to-traversability arrow are inferred wider resonances, and neither is a surah thesis or a literal claim that worship builds roads.

epistemic.reason: The retrospective wide source is legacy-unbound; each retained branch has a focus carrier, a distinct exact wider connection, and a changed reading, but both arrows are explicitly inferential.

branch_activations.activation: Bu dış cevap düzeni, Rabb carrier'ını topluluğu aşama aşama gözeten ve tamamlayan care facet'ine bağlar.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: House'un Rabb'ine yönelen worship, sürdürülen provision'a cevap veren bir yükümlülük olarak da görünür.
branch_activations.boundary: Bu, care facet'inin wider activation'ıdır; literal ebeveynlik veya bütün hane bakım dalları söylenmez.

Global packet'te selected_context_units ve lane_context_refs boştur. Aynı surahın retrospective anlatıları tek başına global trigger sayılmadı; retained global readings için ayrıca exact wider connection kullanıldı.

Covenant adaylarında güvenlikten bağlayıcı güvenceye geçiş açıkça adlandırılmış bir pact'e dayanmıyor; finding-7'nin trusted reject grade'i karşı-evidence olarak tutuldu ve kapsam exploratory ile sınırlandı.
Made-passable-road adayının B005 çekirdeği analogik olarak korundu; trusted yayındaki daha geniş B005+B010 kaydı reject olduğu için B010 açıkça dışlandı.
No-value connection rows attached to supplied semantics were retained as review friction or exclusion evidence and were not used as activation triggers.

Ek bir uncandidate global branch activation, focus carrier'a dönen bağımsız wider trigger, değişmiş okuma ve anlamlı reader payoff koşullarının tümünü karşılamadı; bağlantıların çoğu primary worship/House paraleli veya yalnızca tekrar niteliğinde kaldı.
